title: VEHICLE FLUID LIFETIME ANALYZER
description: Comprehensive 2-prompt pack covering automotive fluid testing and 12V parasitic draw isolation.
content:
PART 1: VEHICLE FLUID LIFETIME ANALYZER
Act as an experienced master mechanic. Provide a strict analysis checklist for inspecting a vehicle's fluid degradation state based on visual properties and chemical test strip readouts.

The procedure must systematically assess the following:
1. Engine Oil context profiling: Evaluate color, smell for fuel dilution, and texture characteristics for a vehicle with {{Engine Mileage: 100,000}} miles.
2. Automatic Transmission Fluid (ATF): Isolate oxidation indicators by checking color shifts from vibrant red to {{ATF Color State|*Light Brown, Dark Brown/Black, Pink/Milky}}.
3. Brake Fluid Moisture Scan: Determine copper contamination thresholds using standard digital multimeter DC millivolt readings or test strip PPM indicators.
